gen-vast-shadow-gf-puritan: Retro showpiece lettering, every stroke cut to one width. Puritan follows in rounded forms with oversized e and a counters, and Vast Shadow earns its keep when it runs big and brief.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-questrial: Questrial brings open, modern letters with a flat, stencil-cut feel and a tall band of lowercase. Questrial against Vast Shadow's spaced-out, single-width strokes feels like a sleek sans sitting under a poster from another era.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-radio-canada: Vast Shadow draws every stroke at a single width, like bent wire. Radio Canada does the quieter work, with full, tall lowercase and curves that stay open at every end, while the heading grabs attention.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-saira: Bent-paperclip lettering with no thick-thin shifts. And Saira's rounded letters stretch tall and keep every s see-through, which gives Vast Shadow a steady, modern partner.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-sofia-sans: Cut-stencil charm from top to bottom, with no thick-thin modulation in either font. Vast Shadow looks best sized up for a few bold words, and Sofia Sans can follow in its rounded, open-sided lowercase.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-stack-sans-notch: Rod-stock lettering, retro on top and sturdy below. Vast Shadow earns its keep when it's big and short, and Stack Sans Notch fills in with open curves and a big-bodied lowercase.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-stack-sans-text: Modern in feel, Stack Sans Text draws its big-bodied lowercase with a marker-like constant line and curve endings kept well apart. Vast Shadow handles the showy part; this body handles the reading.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-ubuntu-sans: Ubuntu Sans has lowercase eyes as big as washers and tubular strokes like bent copper pipe, with curves that stop short of closing. Paragraphs would read open and smooth.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-yaldevi: Glass tubing bent into letters, vintage and showy from the first glance. And Yaldevi settles beneath with outsized lowercase and an e that opens clearly to the right, a calm foil for Vast Shadow's spaced-out forms.
gen-vast-shadow-source-serif-4: Pipe-cleaner letterforms, each stroke cut to one width, give Vast Shadow its look. And if the heading shrinks small, those spaced-out strokes lose their punch while Source Serif 4 keeps its wedge-pen curves and gaping c.
